summary: A button showing the chosen date that opens a popover holding a calendar; picking a day closes the popover.
use: A choice made inside a popover (date, option, color) that should dismiss it and hand focus back to the trigger.
spec: `{#snippet triggerChild(props)}` renders `<Button {...props}>` labelled with the selected date or `Pick a date`
`{#snippet children({ close })}` renders `<Calendar bind:value label="Due date" locale="en-US" weekStartsOn={0} onchange={() => close()} />`
`close()` closes the popover and returns focus to the trigger
